title: Lash Sy Lipti Hui
body:
Lash sy lipti hui kehti thi maa marra gya
Is zahifi mein mera akbar jawan marra gya
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Aik bety sy juri thi maa ki sari kainaat
Ajj laila k liye sara jhan marra gya
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Gam zdda bhai zmee ko daikhta he reh gya
Jab ye qattil ne kha akbar yhan marra gya
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haye ghurbat teen din ki peyas ka marra hua
Nehar orr khaimoun k bil kull darmiyan marra gya
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Abb duaoun sy koi laila ka natta he nhi
Jisko jeeny ki dua daiti thi maa marra gya
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ik nazar qasid ko daikha orr akbar sou gaye
Aamday mehmaa hui orr mezbaan marra gya
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ahly gham seenoun pe akbar hath apny maar kr
Keh rhy hein zulm ka nezza yhan marra gya
